ios.desc:
Your pocket reading sanctuary. No noise, just stories.
Transform any messy webpage into a beautiful reading experience. Scroll extracts the good stuff—clean text, crisp images, perfect typography—so you can focus on what matters: the story.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Scroll – read later app that works offline and doesn't get in your way

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I built Scroll, a minimal read-later app that lets you save articles offline, organize them cleanly, and even read them with a native TTS engine.

I was frustrated with bloated apps like Pocket and Instapaper, so I made something focused purely on distraction-free reading.

Would love feedback from the HN crowd—especially around UX, performance, and any must-have features I missed.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/scroll-read-later/id6748611211
